Application Data.NAME: Valor Surplus Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Valor Surplus Store specializes in the retail sale of authentic military surplus items, including clothing, camping gear, and outdoor equipment. Our operations prioritize compliance with national security regulations, ensuring all products are sourced from verified U.S. military channels. We maintain a comprehensive inventory management system that documents the provenance and legality of all items sold. Our store is equipped with a monitored alarm system and video surveillance to safeguard our merchandise. Additionally, we conduct regular staff training on security procedures and customer service, focusing on maintaining a secure and compliant shopping environment. Our commitment to sourcing only legally permitted surplus items ensures we adhere to all applicable federal regulations, including ITAR and EAR. We strive to provide a reliable shopping experience for our customers while mitigating risks associated with theft and liability.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On February 15, 2023, we experienced a theft incident at our store, resulting in a loss of $3,500 in military surplus gear. The stolen items included various camping equipment and clothing. The incident was reported to local law enforcement, and an investigation is ongoing. We have since implemented additional security measures, including enhanced surveillance and staff training, to prevent future incidents. Status: Ongoing investigation, no recovery of items as of yet.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed, Certified for secure storage of military surplus items.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored alarm system with 24/7 surveillance, on-site security personnel during business hours, and secure storage facilities for high-value items.
